The markdown processing interface is `markdown.Service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

The concrete implementation is an unexported `service` struct returned by `markdown.NewService`. It is constructed in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` inside `NewAPIV1Service`, which passes `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()`. Tests also build it via `markdown.NewService()` in test helpers. `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` holds the interface type directly. `RSSService.MarkdownService` holds it too, receiving the same instance through server.go wiring.

`memopayload.Runner` declares a `MarkdownService` field, but `server.go` never instantiates it. Instead, `RebuildMemoPayload` accepts the service directly as a parameter from `APIV1Service`. Only one concrete implementation executes at runtime: the unexported `service` struct.

`MarkdownRenderer` is a concrete struct used directly; it is not behind an interface. `EditorController` handles frontend markdown editing contracts, not backend processing. The backend goldmark service remains the correct answer.

The main markdown processing interface is `markdown.Service`.

The concrete implementation is the unexported struct `service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. It is constructed by `markdown.NewService` with tag and mention extensions inside `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. `APIV1Service` and `RSSService` both hold the interface as a field. `memopayload.Runner` also holds it, though `NewRunner` is never called in production.

The interface is also passed as a parameter to `RebuildMemoPayload`.

The question concerns the backend `markdown.Service` interface.

The concrete implementation is an unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. It is constructed by `markdown.NewService()` inside `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. The interface is held by `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` and `RSSService.MarkdownService`, which share the same instance.

`memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` is another holder. The production server does not instantiate `memopayload.Runner`; instead, `RebuildMemoPayload` receives the service as a parameter. The three holders are `APIV1Service`, `RSSService`, and `memopayload.Runner`.

`MarkdownRenderer` is a concrete struct used internally by the service and is not behind an interface. The production construction chain runs from `server.NewServer` through `apiv1.NewAPIV1Service` into `markdown.NewService`, which returns `&service{md: md}`. `server.NewServer` then passes that instance into `rss.NewRSSService`.

h13.

**Backend (`markdown.Service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`)**

- **impl** — The only runtime concrete type is the unexported `service` struct (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`), returned by `NewService`. It wraps a goldmark parser; `RenderMarkdown` / `RenameTag` also call the concrete `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`), but that renderer is not behind its own interface.
- **construction** — `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` inside `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`). `server/server.go` passes that same instance into `rss.NewRSSService(..., apiV1Service.MarkdownService)`.
- **holders** — `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`); `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go`); `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, field on the type — `NewRunner` is not wired in `server/server.go`, but memo APIs call `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(..., s.MarkdownService)` from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`).

**Frontend (separate “markdown through an interface” contract: `EditorController` in `web/src/components/MemoEditor/types/editorController.ts`)**

- **impl** — The object returned by `createController()` (`web/src/components/MemoEditor/Editor/controller.ts`), backed by CodeMirror’s `EditorView`.
- **construction** — `createController(view, createFormattingController(...))` in a `useLayoutEffect` inside `web/src/components/MemoEditor/Editor/index.tsx`.
- **holders** — `EditorController` refs held by `EditorContent`, parent `Editor`, `FormattingToolbar`, and hooks such as `useEditorActiveState` / `useMemoInit` (all under `web/src/components/MemoEditor/`).
